# requires: wire
#
# wire-version-changed with the other validator. Plenty of servers publish no
# ETag at all, so Last-Modified is the only token a resume can offer them, and
# an implementation that records one and an implementation that does not are
# indistinguishable until the day a file changes.
#
# The date is an IMF-fixdate, which is the one spelling RFC 9110 requires a
# server to send. What the three do with the obsolete spellings is NOT compared
# here and they do not agree; see feedback/2026-09-06-wire-gaps.md.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:modified
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40 stale
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40,"validators":{"last_modified":"Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT"}}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 6: cp={"verified_prefix":64,"validators":{"last_modified":"Mon, 07 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT"}} [DL-V4]
# expect 7: ok -
